Short Description: Critical Wounds on X+ against specified keyword
Long Description: ANTI: This ability always takes the form [ANTI-X Y+]. Each time an attack is made with an [ANTI] weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by X, an unmodified Wound roll of Y+ is a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 2+ vs FLY
Long Description: ANTI-FLY 2+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a FLY unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 2+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 4+ vs FLY
Long Description: ANTI-FLY 4+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a FLY unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 4+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 2+ vs INFANTRY
Long Description: ANTI-INFANTRY 2+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a INFANTRY unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 2+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 4+ vs INFANTRY
Long Description: ANTI-INFANTRY 4+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a INFANTRY unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 4+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 2+ vs MONSTER
Long Description: ANTI-MONSTER 2+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a MONSTER unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 2+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 4+ vs MONSTER
Long Description: ANTI-MONSTER 4+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a MONSTER unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 4+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 5+ vs MONSTER
Long Description: ANTI-MONSTER 5+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a MONSTER unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 4+ vs PSYKER
Long Description: ANTI-PSYKER 4+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a PSYKER unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 4+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 2+ vs VEHICLE
Long Description: ANTI-VEHICLE 2+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 2+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 3+ vs VEHICLE
Long Description: ANTI-VEHICLE 3+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 3+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 4+ vs VEHICLE
Long Description: ANTI-VEHICLE 4+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 4+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Critical Wounds on 5+ vs VEHICLE
Long Description: ANTI-VEHICLE 5+: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit, an unmodified Wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

Short Description: Unit can shoot using Assault Shooting
Long Description: ASSAULT: Units containing one or more models with an [ASSAULT] weapon can shoot using Assault Shooting.

Short Description: Add +1 attack die per 5 target models
Long Description: BLAST: Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add one additional attack die for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step, rounding down. If this ability takes the form [BLAST X], add X additional attack dice for every five target models instead.

Short Description: Add +X attack dice per 5 target models if targeting one unit
Long Description: CLEAVE: This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step, rounding down.

Short Description: Add +1 melee attack per 5 target models
Long Description: CLEAVE 1: When determining this melee weapon’s number of attacks, add 1 for every five models in the target unit, rounding down.

Short Description: Add +2 attack dice per 5 target models if targeting one unit
Long Description: CLEAVE 2: Each time you gather attack dice for this weapon, if you only selected one target for all of this weapon’s attacks, add 2 additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step, rounding down.

Short Description: Can shoot while engaged; must target engaged enemy
Long Description: CLOSE-QUARTERS: This weapon can be shot while the bearer’s unit is within Engagement Range, but must target one of those enemy units.

Short Description: Unit can shoot using Close-Quarters Shooting
Long Description: CLOSE-QUARTERS: Units containing one or more models with a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon can shoot using Close-Quarters Shooting. When using another shooting type, for each model in that unit, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE models, select either one or more of its [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons or one or more of its other ranged weapons to make attacks with.

Short Description: -1 to Hit while at 1-10 wounds remaining
Long Description: Damaged 1-5: While this model has 1-5 wounds remaining, subtract 1 from the Hit roll each time this model makes an attack.

Short Description: -1 to Hit while at 1-4 wounds remaining
Long Description: Damaged 1-4: While this model has 1-4 wounds remaining, subtract 1 from the Hit roll each time this model makes an attack.

Short Description: -1 to Hit while at 1-5 wounds remaining
Long Description: Damaged 1-5: While this model has 1-5 wounds remaining, subtract 1 from the Hit roll each time this model makes an attack.

Short Description: On destruction, roll 6: units within 6" suffer X mortal wounds
Long Description: Deadly Demise: This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model in this unit is destroyed, after units embarked within it have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise. Each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X. If X is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6".

Short Description: On 6, units within 6" suffer 1 mortal wound
Long Description: Deadly Demise 1: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers 1 mortal wound.

Short Description: On 6, units within 6" suffer 2D6 mortal wounds
Long Description: Deadly Demise D6: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers D6 mortal wounds. Roll separately for each affected unit.

Short Description: On 6, units within 6" suffer D3 mortal wounds
Long Description: Deadly Demise D3: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds. Roll separately for each affected unit.

Short Description: On 6, units within 6" suffer D6 mortal wounds
Long Description: Deadly Demise D6: When this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from play. On a 6, each unit within 6" suffers D6 mortal wounds. Roll separately for each affected unit.

Short Description: Ingress: set up more than 8" from enemies
Long Description: Deep Strike: Each time this unit makes an ingress move, if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even within your opponent’s deployment zone.

Short Description: Set up in Reserves; arrive more than 9" from enemies
Long Description: Deep Strike: During the Declare Battle Formations step, if every model in this unit has this ability, you can set it up in Reserves instead of on the battlefield. In your Reinforcements step, set it up more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models.

Short Description: Critical Wounds inflict mortal wounds; no saves
Long Description: DEVASTATING WOUNDS: Each time an attack with this weapon scores a Critical Wound, no saving throw can be made and the target suffers mortal wounds equal to the weapon’s Damage characteristic.

Short Description: Critical Wound: inflict Damage as mortal wounds; excess does not spill over
Long Description: DEVASTATING WOUNDS: Each time an attack made with a [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon results in a Critical Wound, the attack sequence ends and the target unit suffers mortal wounds equal to that weapon’s Damage characteristic. These mortal wounds are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks. Mortal wounds inflicted by a [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon can damage a maximum of one model for each Critical Wound. Any remaining mortal wounds inflicted by that attack are lost.

Short Description: Attack with this plus another melee weapon
Long Description: EXTRA ATTACKS: Each time the bearer fights, it makes attacks with this weapon in addition to one other melee weapon it is equipped with.

Short Description: Attack with these weapons in addition to one other melee weapon
Long Description: EXTRA ATTACKS: Each time a unit containing one or more models with an [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon fights, those models make attacks with those weapons in addition to any others. In the Select Weapons step, for each of those models, select all of that model’s [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapons and one of that model’s other melee weapons, if possible.

Short Description: Roll X+ to prevent a lost wound
Long Description: Feel No Pain: This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6. On an X+, that wound is not lost.

Short Description: Ignore lost wounds on 5+
Long Description: Feel No Pain 5+: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6. On a 5+, that wound is not lost.

Short Description: Ignore lost wounds on 6+
Long Description: Feel No Pain 6+: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6. On a 6+, that wound is not lost.

Short Description: Unit is a Fights First unit while every model has this ability
Long Description: Fights First: While every model in a unit has this ability, that unit is a Fights First unit.

Short Description: Fight in the Fights First step
Long Description: Fights First: Units with this ability that are eligible to fight do so in the Fights First step, provided every model in the unit has this ability.

Short Description: Firing Deck 11
Long Description: Firing Deck: This ability always takes the form Firing Deck X. In your Shooting phase, each time this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, if one or more units are embarked within it, select up to X embarked models, excluding models whose units have already been selected to shoot this phase. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons, excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons. Until this TRANSPORT has resolved all of its attacks, it has all selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this TRANSPORT are not eligible to shoot.

Short Description: Firing Deck 12
Long Description: Firing Deck: This ability always takes the form Firing Deck X. In your Shooting phase, each time this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, if one or more units are embarked within it, select up to X embarked models, excluding models whose units have already been selected to shoot this phase. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons, excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons. Until this TRANSPORT has resolved all of its attacks, it has all selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this TRANSPORT are not eligible to shoot.

Short Description: Firing Deck 6
Long Description: Firing Deck: This ability always takes the form Firing Deck X. In your Shooting phase, each time this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, if one or more units are embarked within it, select up to X embarked models, excluding models whose units have already been selected to shoot this phase. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons, excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons. Until this TRANSPORT has resolved all of its attacks, it has all selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this TRANSPORT are not eligible to shoot.

Short Description: After use, failed Hazardous test causes mortals
Long Description: HAZARDOUS: After this unit resolves attacks, make one Hazardous test for each Hazardous weapon used. For each failed test, one equipped model suffers 3 mortal wounds.

Short Description: After shooting or fighting, make Hazard rolls for selected weapons
Long Description: HAZARDOUS: Each time a unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make a number of Hazard rolls for that unit equal to the number of [HAZARDOUS] weapons selected in the Select Weapons step.

Short Description: Add +1 to Hit if Remained Stationary
Long Description: HEAVY: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, if the bearer’s unit Remained Stationary this turn, add 1 to that attack’s Hit roll.

Short Description: Add +1 to Hit if unengaged, not newly set up, and moved no more than 3"
Long Description: HEAVY: In your Shooting phase, each time an attack is made with a [HEAVY] weapon, add 1 to the Hit roll if all of the following apply to the attacking unit: that unit is unengaged; that unit was not set up on the battlefield this turn; no model in that unit has moved more than 3" this turn.

Short Description: Takes to the Skies without subtracting 2"
Long Description: Hover: Each time this unit takes to the skies, do not subtract 2" from the maximum distance.

Short Description: Critical Hits automatically wound MONSTER/VEHICLE
Long Description: HUNTER: MONSTER/VEHICLE: Each time an attack made with this weapon against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit results in a Critical Hit, that attack automatically wounds the target.

Short Description: Target cannot get Benefit of Cover
Long Description: IGNORES COVER: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, the target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Short Description: Target cannot receive Benefit of Cover
Long Description: IGNORES COVER: Each time an attack is made with an [IGNORES COVER] weapon, the target cannot have the Benefit of Cover against that attack, including from rules that give a model or unit the Benefit of Cover.

Short Description: Can shoot targets not visible; penalties if none visible
Long Description: INDIRECT FIRE: This weapon can target units that are not visible. If no target models are visible, subtract 1 from Hit rolls, unmodified Hit rolls of 1-3 fail, and the target has Benefit of Cover.

Short Description: Unit can shoot using Indirect Shooting
Long Description: INDIRECT FIRE: Units containing one or more models with an [INDIRECT FIRE] weapon can shoot using Indirect Shooting.

Short Description: Deploy anywhere more than 9" from enemy deployment and models
Long Description: Infiltrators: During deployment, if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

Short Description: Deploy more than 8" from enemy deployment zone and enemy units
Long Description: Infiltrators: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

Short Description: Add +1 to Wound after Charge
Long Description: LANCE: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, if the bearer made a Charge move this turn, add 1 to that attack’s Wound roll.

Short Description: Add +1 to Wound after Charge
Long Description: LANCE: Each time an attack is made with a [LANCE] weapon, if the attacking model’s unit made a Charge move this turn, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Short Description: See Attached Units rules
Long Description: Leader: See Attached Units.

Short Description: Can lead listed non-Terminator and non-Gravis units
Long Description: Leader: This model can be attached to the following units: Assault Intercessor Squad; Bladeguard Veteran Squad; Company Heroes; Hellblaster Squad; Infernus Squad; Intercessor Squad; Sternguard Veteran Squad; Tactical Squad; Victrix Honour Guard. This model cannot be attached to a Bladeguard Veteran Squad unless equipped with a relic shield, and cannot be attached to a Hellblaster Squad unless equipped with a plasma pistol.

Short Description: Can lead listed units and can join one Captain or Chapter Master
Long Description: Leader: This model can be attached to the following units: Assault Intercessor Squad; Bladeguard Veteran Squad; Company Heroes; Hellblaster Squad; Infernus Squad; Intercessor Squad; Sternguard Veteran Squad; Tactical Squad. You can attach this model to a unit it can lead even if one Captain or Chapter Master model has already been attached to it.

Short Description: Can lead Outriders
Long Description: Leader: This model can be attached to Outrider Squad units.

Short Description: Critical Hits automatically wound
Long Description: LETHAL HITS: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, a Critical Hit automatically wounds the target.

Short Description: Critical Hit can automatically wound
Long Description: LETHAL HITS: Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a Critical Hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. If you do, no Wound roll is made for that attack.

Short Description: Cannot be shot unless attacker is within 12"
Long Description: Lone Operative: Unless part of an Attached unit, this unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 12".

Short Description: Not visible beyond 12"; INDIRECT FIRE cannot target beyond 12"
Long Description: Lone Operative: Unless part of an Attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. If this ability takes the form Lone Operative X", replace 12" with X".

Short Description: Add +2 Damage within half range
Long Description: Melta X: Each time a model makes an attack with a [MELTA] weapon, if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step, until the attacking unit’s attacks have been resolved, add X to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

Short Description: Can only attack once per battle
Long Description: One Shot: Each weapon with this ability can only be selected to make attacks with once per battle. If a destroyed model is returned to a unit, any One Shot weapons already used cannot be selected again. If a new unit is added to an army, its One Shot weapons can each be selected once per battle.

Short Description: Can shoot in Engagement Range; cannot shoot with non-Pistols
Long Description: PISTOL: This weapon can be shot while the bearer’s unit is within Engagement Range, but must target one of those enemy units. Non-MONSTER and non-VEHICLE models cannot shoot Pistols and non-Pistol weapons together.

Short Description: Identical to CLOSE-QUARTERS
Long Description: Pistol: [PISTOL] and [CLOSE-QUARTERS] are identical for all rules purposes. See [CLOSE-QUARTERS].

Short Description: Can allocate wounds to visible CHARACTER in Attached unit
Long Description: PRECISION: Each time an attack made with this weapon wounds an Attached unit, if a CHARACTER model in that unit is visible, the attacker can allocate that attack to that CHARACTER model.

Short Description: Visible CHARACTER group can become the allocation group
Long Description: Precision: While resolving attacks made with one or more [PRECISION] weapons, at the start of the Allocation Order step, if the target unit contains one or more CHARACTER models visible to one or more attacking models, the active player can select one allocation group containing one of those visible CHARACTER models. Until those attacks are resolved, or until that CHARACTER group is destroyed, that CHARACTER group is the current allocation group.

Short Description: Wounds from this weapon count as Psychic Attacks
Long Description: PSYCHIC: If this weapon causes a unit to suffer one or more wounds, those wounds are considered to have been inflicted by a Psychic Attack.

Short Description: Ignore BS, WS, and Hit roll modifiers
Long Description: Psychic: Each time an attack is made with a [PSYCHIC] weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s BS or WS characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll. Attacks made with [PSYCHIC] weapons are known as psychic attacks.

Short Description: Add +1 attacks within half range
Long Description: RAPID FIRE 1: Each time this weapon targets a unit within half this weapon’s range, increase this weapon’s Attacks characteristic by 1.

Short Description: Add +2 attacks within half range
Long Description: RAPID FIRE 2: Each time this weapon targets a unit within half this weapon’s range, increase this weapon’s Attacks characteristic by 2.

Short Description: Add +3 attacks within half range
Long Description: RAPID FIRE 3: Each time this weapon targets a unit within half this weapon’s range, increase this weapon’s Attacks characteristic by 3.

Short Description: Add +4 attacks within half range
Long Description: RAPID FIRE 4: Each time this weapon targets a unit within half this weapon’s range, increase this weapon’s Attacks characteristic by 4.

Short Description: Add +8 attacks within half range
Long Description: RAPID FIRE 8: Each time this weapon targets a unit within half this weapon’s range, increase this weapon’s Attacks characteristic by 8.

Short Description: Add +D3 attacks within half range
Long Description: RAPID FIRE D3: Each time this weapon targets a unit within half this weapon’s range, increase this weapon’s Attacks characteristic by D3.

Short Description: Add +X attack dice within half range
Long Description: Rapid Fire X: Each time you gather attack dice for a [RAPID FIRE] weapon, add X additional attack dice if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step.

Short Description: Pre-battle: deploy from Reserves or make Scout Move
Pre-battle: deploy from Reserves or make Scout Move
Hit MONSTER/VEHICLE: Add +2 to Charge and blocks Overwatch
Long Description: SNAGGED: Each time this weapon scores a hit against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, until the end of the turn, if the bearer selects that unit as a charge target, add 2 to that Charge roll and that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch at the bearer.

Short Description: -1 to ranged Hit rolls against this unit
Long Description: Stealth: If every model in this unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack is made against it, subtract 1 from that attack’s Hit roll.

Short Description: Gain Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks
Long Description: Stealth: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Short Description: Move through models and short terrain; optional MOBILE keyword
Long Description: Super-Heavy Walker: Each time a unit with this ability makes a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move, models in that unit can move through models, including MONSTER and VEHICLE models but excluding TITANIC models, and can move horizontally through terrain features that are 4" or less in height. Before moving, you can select for all models in that unit to have the MOBILE keyword until that move ends. If you do, when that move ends, roll one D6: on a 1, that unit is Battle-shocked.

Short Description: Can be assigned to front-line squads
Long Description: Support: See Attached Units.

Short Description: Critical Hits score 1 additional hit
Long Description: SUSTAINED HITS 1: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, a Critical Hit scores 1 additional hit.

Short Description: Critical Hits score 2 additional hits
Long Description: SUSTAINED HITS 2: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, a Critical Hit scores 2 additional hits.

Short Description: Critical Hit scores X additional hits
Long Description: Sustained Hits X: Each time an attack made with a [SUSTAINED HITS] weapon results in a Critical Hit, that attack results in X additional hits on the target.

Short Description: Automatically hits
Long Description: Torrent: Each time an attack is made with a [TORRENT] weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.

Short Description: Re-roll the Wound roll
Long Description: Twin-Linked: Each time an attack is made with a [TWIN-LINKED] weapon, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
